description: A universal commerce gateway for AI agents to interact with UCP-enabled stores. Enables live product discovery, real-time catalog search, and checkout generation across verified Shopify stores (e.g., Allbirds, Gymshark). Use this to find products, verify merchant capabilities, and facilitate end-to-end shopping journeys via the Universal Commerce Protocol.
